issue.title: test_handler_output_passes_prettier_check fails under bare pytest in an agent shell but passes in sase tool run check
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1tz.3.1.9 (bundle_trim, note #4) and seen again by sase-1tz.3.1.4 (note #6); filed by the sase-1tz.3.1 land agent.

`tests/main/test_init_skills_formatting.py::test_handler_output_passes_prettier_check` fails deterministically under bare `.venv/bin/python -m pytest` from a SASE agent shell on the clean master tree (reproduced 2026-11-20 on f6b4344d87 in this land agent's workspace). It passes inside `sase tool run check`.

Observed: the generated `SKILL.md` under the test's tmp home is not re-wrapped. The body keeps the stub's hard wrap from `tests/main/init_skills_handler_helpers.py::stub_under_wrapped_skill`, so `prettier --prose-wrap=always --print-width=88 --parser=markdown --check` exits 1. `prettier` on PATH is the nvm global 3.8.1, the same version as the repo's `node_modules/.bin/prettier`, so a version skew is ruled out. The handler's formatting path (`src/sase/main/init_skills_handler.py` `_format_skill_outputs`, with `use_prettier` gating) appears not to run, or to run differently, in the bare environment. The root cause, likely an environment variable or config the `sase tool run` wrapper sets or scrubs, is not yet established.

Impact: phase agents running focused suites with bare pytest see a red test that looks like a regression and spend time proving it is pre-existing. The test should be hermetic: either pin the environment it depends on, or skip with a clear reason when the formatter is not active.

task_type_fields.repro: From a SASE agent shell on master f6b4344d87: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/main/test_init_skills_formatting.py::test_handler_output_passes_prettier_check -> prettier --check exits 1 on an unwrapped SKILL.md; passes inside sase tool run check.

issue.creation_reason: Two sase-1tz.3.1 phases (bundle_trim, swap_launch_guards) independently hit this deterministic environment-dependent failure on the clean base and spent time proving it pre-existing.

evidence.note: Root cause found by the sase-1vd land agent: prettier 3 reads .gitignore as an ignore file by default, and sase's .gitignore lists '.cache/'. Agent shells set TMPDIR under ~/.cache/sase/tmp/agent-tmp/..., so _init_skills_rendering.format_unique_skill_outputs_batch writes its temp SKILL.md files there, and 'prettier --write' run from a sase checkout silently skips them (rc=0, no output, file unchanged). Repro: write an under-wrapped .md into a tempfile.mkdtemp() dir from the sase_13 workspace and run prettier --prose-wrap=always --print-width=88 --parser=markdown --write on it. It is unchanged from the workspace cwd and formatted from cwd=/ or under /tmp. Impact goes beyond the test: agent-run 'sase skill init' deploys write unformatted SKILL.md files. chezmoi 888098c1 (sase-1vd.7 deploy) re-wrapped 'Before doing anything else, run this command to record that you\nare using this skill:', and d4cb694c kept that. Likely fixes: pass --ignore-path with an empty file, or run prettier with cwd set to the temp dir.
